Prove Job same-node affinity, RWO coexistence, no live fsGroup permission rewrites and full strict source traversal
Confirm native bundle capacity plus two retained generations, and all mover/verify/replication Job deadlines
Prove native process lifetime and functional availability across capture, no stops/freezes/restarts
Select one exact NAS manifest and its exact R2 lineage, restore each independently into isolated targets
Verify bundle checksums/COMPLETE and original application-level state equality; repository verification and Ready are insufficient
Keep every VolSync source and original repository/history intact until separate per-workload retirement acceptance
safe_original_recovery_command: test "$RECOVERY_TARGET" = isolated && test -n "$BUNDLE" && curl --disable --fail --silent --show-error --noproxy '*' --config /run/isolated-es-curl.conf -H 'Content-Type: application/x-ndjson' --data-binary @"$BUNDLE/elasticsearch.ndjson" http://127.0.0.1:19200/_bulk
recovery_command_gate: Execute only against new isolated recovery target, never production volume/database/service
Obtain BUNDLE from exact completed Kopiur Restore target; do not synthesize or substitute a fixture
Verify every bundle checksum and terminal Restore phase Completed before running native command

For Tube Archivist precreate exact reviewed catalog with restored mappings/settings/aliases in new ES, inspect bulk response errors/items, restore Django SQL and original auth; this command alone is not acceptance
For Plex/Stash extract state archive into empty target and replay native DB copies, never raw live DB/WAL files
For RomM restore assets/resources, effective config and original auth key before isolated native boot
unproven: complete external NFS and shared service recovery
native pinned-image fixture execution blocked locally by Docker ENOSPC
actual native application boot and original application-level data equality
isolated_restore_tool: kubernetes/apps/media/tubearchivist/app/restore.py --isolated --bundle <exact-native-bundle> --cache <empty>; fixed loopback ES only, no production endpoint or credentials
